fixed.what: compare anon and score keep the ledger head they computed from and re-read the ledger under run.lock before writing; if it moved the run exits 75 (lock-lost) and writes nothing.
fixed.test_added: compare T24 (a plan amend lands while the run waits for a lock the test holds; result is 75 with nothing written, or the amended plan, never the old label)

fixed.what: compare blindingOf returns scores-invalid unless every key item is answered exactly once and every guess_arm is one of the key's arms.

fixed.test_added: compare T3 (seed is 64 hex, differs from sha256('blind:'+plan sha), differs between runs, kept on repeat); mutant CM7 now caught

fixed.what: compare anon exits 2 arms-not-committed, writing nothing and no key, unless every arm named in arm_tasks is committed.

tests.command: node tools/lane.mjs --label fix-U5-* --timeout-s 300 -- node --test --test-concurrency=1 tcb/test/<protocol-freeze|compare|gate|cost>.test.mjs (one file per lane call)
tests.output_tail: protocol-freeze: tests 29, pass 27, skip 2; compare: tests 27, pass 25, skip 2; gate: tests 24, pass 22, skip 2; cost: tests 26, pass 24, skip 2. Every skip is an NA test that needs the app. Mutation re-run through the lane: all 20 mutants (the 5 survivors CM3, CM7, GT7, KC2, KC3 plus 15 for the new code) are caught by the named test. Return written to done/fix-U5.json.

lib_change_requests: status.mjs and CONTRACT 3.x (owner line): the owner approve line should record draft_sha256 = sha256(canonicalize(draft without its approval field)) of the protocol or analysis-plan draft at the moment of approval. protocol-freeze already checks it when present; once status.mjs writes it, protocol-freeze should drop the allowance for a line without the field (U5-PF-1).
replace.mjs and spec/briefs.md: render {{role}} as a neutral label (for example 'solo' for the control role) so the S1 session is not told it is the control (U5-B-1).

Spec amendments, no lib change: compare (random seed only in the sealed key; anon exits 2 arms-not-committed unless every planned arm is committed; both modes exit 75 when the ledger moved under the lock; tokens null for a task with no row or an attempt with no transcript; scorer result must answer every key item with a guess_arm among the key's arms); gate (G1..G12 required alongside P1..P21; a hazard id may not change classical_name, statement or severity); cost (unreadable cards or commit records go into missing and make the run untrusted; default inputs only beside the script).
